plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Production Desk shares your location with your Admin and Field Supervisor while signed in, including when your phone is locked. Customers only see your location through a trip link. Stop sharing in the app to sign out.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Production Desk requires your location while signed in so your office can coordinate scheduled work.
